facts.fact: The Resin House well house stands behind the kennel roof at the end of a flagged path: four posts, old tile, shuttered windows, plank door with an iron hasp, a farm lock and a teak bar in two brackets. Chathu carries the black book to it at dusk and returns without it.
facts.why: needed because the beat locates the ledger there and the next chapter's question depends on its lock.

facts.fact: The Resin House has eight hunters on the walls: two at the main gate, two at the drain, four under the wall. About forty members train in the yards.
facts.why: needed because the beat calls for the ridge survey with hunters and forty members.

facts.fact: Neela uses her last smear of Ammu's resin on the ridge at dusk to turn and scout the well house; Devan holds a pebble in his cheek until she is back at dawn. She now has the full flask of fresh resin from a stray nightbark on the ridge.
facts.why: needed because the beat empties Ammu's pouch and ends on the book being reachable only by hands.

facts.fact: Neela cuts her right palm tapping the tree; a matching welt rises on Devan's right palm.
facts.why: needed because the beat shows the wound-share cut.

facts.fact: Pachan is tall, stooped, long-faced, in a grey wrap; he gave ten-year-old Neela a sweet when Chathu sat her at the table.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him recognise her and lower his pole.
